snippet.title: Jurassic World Evolution 3 | Cretaceous Cruise
snippet.description:
The iconic Cretaceous Cruise is coming to Jurassic World Evolution 3! Park Managers can create stunning enclosures for guests to paddle through, admire awe-inspiring dinosaurs from a new perspective, and get up close to semi-aquatic species.

Jurassic World Evolution 3, launching 21 October and available to pre-order now on Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation Store, and Xbox Store.

Pre-order now: https://fron.dev/15e6
